statement: Linux DS4 calibration requests 0x02/37 bytes for USB with up to three attempts when contention returns mismatched reports, and 0x05/41 with CRC for Bluetooth; it computes gyro and accel coefficients, guards zero denominators. Probe may continue with inaccurate IMU if calibration fetch fails.

applicability.revision: research revisions: Linux 4056b3c, historical Linux v6.1 830b3c6, SDL 535d80b, OpenPuck 29f4d1e, community 290e4a2; retail revision unknown
applicability.scope: hid-playstation.c 1938–2116, 2801–2805. Contention with Steam is an explicitly documented kernel-side concern, not proof of actual collision in virtualgamepad.
